# F spatial blocks — mapping and budget (P2-R3 C-2, C-4)

**Payload arithmetic only; no perception output is read and no network is run.**

All three transmitted branches share one 25 × 88 grid; each cell covers 3.2 m × 3.2 m of the 80.0 m × 281.6 m BEV area. Transmitted channels per branch: [16, 64, 256]. The detection head works on a 100 × 352 grid.
